name: Search for an object
description: Find an object whose location is unknown: visit the supports of a room in order of distance and aim the head at each surface until the object is seen.

region.description: Room to search; default the robot's room.

found_on.description: Support under the object when it was seen.

verifier.name: observed
verifier.meaning: The robot saw the target in its head camera during this episode (set by look, search, inspect, explore).
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_plan.selection: first path whose noun conditions all hold, decided before any motion
policy_plan.on_no_match: NO_PATH: the Contract refuses without moving

relations.when: the found object must be fetched
the object is not on any visited support
relations.reason: room coverage marks every visible object observed, including the target

relations.when: the object may be inside a closed cabinet

failure.automatic_fallback: nested calls only: a failed precondition with a matching repair fallback runs the repair once and retries; top-level calls stop
